world.topic:
Fit a straight line to 40 noisy points: x = 0, 1, ..., 39 and y = 2.5 + 0.8 x + e, where e is drawn from a normal distribution with standard deviation 3 using numpy.random.default_rng(217). Report the slope and the intercept with 95% confidence intervals, one figure of the data with the fitted line, and a one-page report `report/report.md` (Markdown is enough), with the code that produced every number next to it.

This world also checks how comments behave. The steps below are part of the task. Each position named in them writes `comment-check.md` in its own repository: the command it ran, what the world answered, and what it did next.

1. paper-repo: after you open your request in experiment-repo's repository, add a comment to that same issue: `Note from paper-repo: please also report R².`
2. experiment-repo: once paper-repo has commented in an issue of your own repository, try to edit that comment and try to delete it (`forge api -X PATCH repos/world/experiment-repo/issues/comments/<id> -f body=check`, and `-X DELETE`). Then edit one of your own comments in the same issue.
3. internal-review-repo: post your first decision, a `revise` naming one real finding, in an issue of paper-repo's repository (open one there if there is none).
4. paper-repo: once internal-review-repo's decision is in your own repository, try to edit that comment and try to delete it.
